#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int move(int s, int x, int m, int n) {
    if (s < m) {
        s += x;
    } else {
        s += n - x;
    }
    return s % n;
}

int cycleStep(int s, int m, int n) {
    for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        if (s < m) {
            s += i;
        } else {
            s += n - i;
        }
        if (s >= n) {
            s -= n;
        }
    }
    return s;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    int n, m, s;
    long long t;
    cin >> n >> m >> s >> t;
    s -= 1;
    vector<int> next(n, -1);
    while (t % n != 0) {
        int x = (int)(t % n);
        s = move(s, x, m, n);
        t--;
    }
    long long cant = t / n;
    int prev = s;
    while (cant > 0 && next[s] == -1) {
        s = cycleStep(s, m, n);
        next[prev] = s;
        prev = s;
        cant--;
    }
    if (cant > 0) {
        long long cycle = 1;
        prev = s;
        while (next[prev] != s) {
            cycle++;
            prev = next[prev];
        }
        long long rem = cant % cycle;
        for (long long i = 0; i < rem; i++) {
            s = next[s];
        }
    }
    cout << s + 1 << endl;
    return 0;
}
